config.goal: Port fused_residual_forward_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/fused_residual_forward.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T C` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 1e-05 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so replace or empty those files once your own port is done. Clear migrated/ (delete SYCLomatic's files or replace them with your own) as soon as your own port compiles, and run scan_helpers on '.' before you finish: helpers left anywhere in the tree fail the run. Every variant keeps its CUDA variant's own algorithm (its atomics, shared memory, warp reductions and launch shape, in SYCL terms): never copy one implementation into several variants.
